dct_description_sm:
Program participants whose email address is provided on their account receive a request for their feedback about their program experience at the end of their last scheduled class. Feedback is captured in four focus areas: program, instructor, registration experience and facility.

The earliest responses are from classes ending in June 2013. This data was extracted from the CLASS system used by Recreation and Culture, which has been replaced with Xplor recreation system in 2021.
